review_method: Actually inspected every assigned native 480x854 PNG in all21 original-resolution2x2 sheets other-01.png through other-21.png using view_image. Also opened personalization-recents-dark-he-largefont-compact.png individually at original resolution to resolve a possible Hebrew summary edge issue: text is visible within the card. Every source file was independently SHA-256 checked, decoded with Pillow, and compared pixel-for-pixel against its unscaled sheet crop. Reviewed only this source10 run, without approval reuse from earlier runs.
bounded_findings: Fixed dialpad FAB partly obscures one lower visible contact/recent-call control in several captured list positions, while upper row controls and the bottom navigation remain distinct. Screenshot review alone does not establish scrolling or tapping reachability; this is a bounded layout observation, not a claim that every visible control is unobscured.

Long contact/favorite names, recent-call date/time metadata, native notification headers and compact widget branding use ellipsis. Full visible phone numbers, principal state/count labels and action icons remain readable. Android CallStyle shortens the longer Hebrew speaker-on action.

Launcher-icon chooser is scrollable: the fifth icon is partial in the initial state and fully shown in the paired bottom state; the bottom state has a partial first row under its fixed header. Settings and list captures likewise include naturally partial adjacent rows at scroll edges.

Light avatar-shape chooser displays plain filled shapes without the initials present in the dark version. The four geometric previews, Hebrew labels, radio markers and Cancel action remain distinguishable.
scope_limits: This report covers exactly82 fresh non-call-design/non-island screenshots; call designs and island/external-call captures require their separate reviewers.

Visual review confirms the pictured pixels only. It does not independently validate dialing, notification action effects, scrolling, permission grants, backup contents/restore effects, widgets on an arbitrary launcher, or persistence.
Fixture screenshots use fictional contacts and call state. Actual modem/Telecom external-call evidence is outside this82-frame visual scope.

The pictured matrix includes English/Hebrew RTL, dark/light themes and named enlarged-font1.3 states on Android13 at480x854/density240. It does not exhaust every theme/font/content combination and is not a physical Jelly Star, SIM/carrier, audio, Bluetooth, proximity, lock-screen, TalkBack or matching-key upgrade verification.
Readability and color separation were assessed visually; this was not a measured WCAG contrast or screen-reader audit. Native Android SystemUI notification shade styling is system-owned.
